deadline.checks: Python tracing, audited opens, profiled C-read boundaries and explicit stage boundaries.
deadline.limit: No signal, child watchdog, force or retry. A blocked OS/C call cannot be preempted; it is rejected on return. Instrumentation overhead is included and prevents interpreting this as uninstrumented reviewer time.

exact_target: Unchanged qualification-harness-v3 review_matrix.review called once with the fourteen accepted matrix receipt paths.
guards: -I -B and exact reviewed ordinary interpreter; no target module preloaded.
Load unchanged source bytes with original filenames/origins, no monkeypatch of reviewer functions or boolean substitute.
Saved path/target inode, link inode, size, mtime, ctime, mode, UID and canonical target checked before/after. Descriptor identity checked at profiled read boundaries.
Private exact source/receipt/snapshot allowlist plus only the three already-budgeted Python3.12 interpreter aliases outside that harness.
No numeric/hardware imports; no later unplanned imports; process, network, thread, signal, filesystem mutation, ctypes and mmap operations blocked.
One exclusive timing-result-01.json descriptor is owned by the wrapper. No input/production writes; any failure is retained and no automatic repeat is authorized.
Full returned matrix object must equal accepted matrix-review-01.json; all exact read counters must equal the saved successful read map.

logical_budget.method: Each audited read-open charges the entire saved file length. Profiled _io.read calls must match audited opens exactly. These are logical source-specific charges, not measured OS read bytes or physical I/O.
logical_budget.per_path_ceilings: Exact saved logical_read_groups.service_v3_review_matrix_once_read_map.visits; no added allowance if it proves inaccurate.

preserved_preparation_read_error.description: A metadata-only exploration first treated visits as a list; KeyError slice(None,2,None) revealed it is a path-to-count dictionary. No target payload opened and no source/test execution occurred.

remaining_unmeasured: Whether the provisional source-derived read map exactly matches the unchanged reviewer execution.
Instrumented elapsed time, physical I/O, cache effects, total05 admission time, repeated admission cost and complete live maintenance duration.
No standalone stage acceptance transfers to enabled production release, owned OS fixture or ProductionHost.

separate_setup_scope.interpretation: Setup verification and poststage metadata checks are included in total elapsed but excluded from the timed reviewer call.
separate_setup_scope.other_reads: Exact saved correction, root assessment, accepted matrix, wrapper/input sidecars, and ordinary timing Python3.14 executable; all separately charged and bounded.
separate_setup_scope.payload_discovery: No traversal; target metadata checks iterate only previously saved selected paths. The reviewer retains its own fixed *.py harness enumeration.

unexecuted_test_plan: Use only temporary inert files and fake clock, never target reviewer/payloads: changed metadata, unbudgeted read/write/control/import, visit/byte/file/read-call ceilings, descriptor drift, deadline and exclusive receipt refusal.
Separately under a parent test slot, exercise one inert full-file read for each actual pathlib read_bytes/read_text method to verify Python3.14 profile-hook accounting.
No current source tests, target imports, timing execution, OS publication probes, process controls or numerical workloads have run.
